blacklistabilityReview.evidence: All four live implementations authorize chain-local Safe 0xf25c404c101d40d88b5dcd64b82583dbc918dd25 for forceTransfer(address,address,uint256) and arbitrary-holder burn(address,uint256), while the shared mint EOA lacks those permissions. Nonzero seizure simulations against actual holders succeeded on Ethereum block 25590408 (hash 0x114ec56a77156d27c6d2d91bf401ca428ffed4aa85f0ff0371b34af67f109052), Base block 48979919 (hash 0x4e8d1eed9b32347b239c53b681c713a167c3f491f0af1b79b7072d0ba3732c83), and Arbitrum block 486632328 (hash 0xc536c0320873e43c1c1d63ee1fdc6cd1b63ccf61cf61ac7c54867bfda503faeb); Monad block 89486097 (hash 0x6d816fae89965dc2323f02e29116adb6550c83b4a8870f8f75d539d10cf1b0be) confirmed selector authorization and a successful Safe call. Current Safe thresholds are Ethereum 3-of-8, Base 3-of-7, Arbitrum 4-of-8, and Monad 4-of-8.

oracleRisk.summary: rwaUSDi is a permissioned private-credit pool token whose value is an issuer-computed net asset value. The issuer documents its oracle architecture as signed NAV/share messages from an authorized signer set (issuer admin, fund admin or designated oracle operators) verified by quorum and freshness checks with delta and divergence guards, and it publishes Chainlink rwaUSDi NAV and Proof of Reserves feeds for the Monad deployment. No independent external price-feed quorum, public feed-controller inventory or published liquidation market for rwaUSDi is disclosed, so the valuation authority is issuer-internal pricing relayed to an external feed rather than independent market-price discovery. Private-credit reserve risk, the documented liquid-pool PriceRouter/UnwindEngine design and the destination CCIP bridge controls remain separate reviews.

branchApplicability.rationale: The reviewed price authority converts rwaUSDi supply into a USD NAV for issuance and redemption; it is not a borrower-collateral liquidation oracle. The issuer's documented UnwindEngine/AuctionHouse flow belongs to the public liquid-collateral pool, while rwaUSDi is described as permissioned private credit pools with scheduled redemptions, defined horizons and no continuous public liquidation path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Multipli issues rwaUSDi natively on Ethereum, Base, Monad, Arbitrum, X Layer, Robinhood Chain, and Pharos; the seven reviewed routes remain issuer-native. The latest implementation is CCIP-admin/IBurnMintERC20-compatible, but the three added implementations expose no remote-token or route-peer configuration, and Robinhood Chain and Pharos TokenAdminRegistry getPool(token) reads were zero. The unresolved CCIP binding is bridge-evidence follow-up in Bridge Risk; it does not make the seven authored deployments representations. Ethereum in the peripheral route rows is an identity/accounting convention, not evidence that the other deployments are bridged.
